props.caption: Xeriscaping Principles — Water-Efficient Landscape Design Diagram
props.description: Six-panel illustration of xeriscaping principles: (1) Native and adapted species — drought-tolerant Philippine natives; (2) Hydrozoning — group plants by water needs; (3) Soil improvement — organic mulch reduces evaporation 50%+; (4) Drip irrigation — 30-50% water savings vs spray; (5) Reduced turf areas — replace with native groundcovers; (6) Permeable surfaces — allow infiltration, reduce flooding. Philippine tropical context annotations.
